plan: Given my value of $9, I should bid slightly less than my value to maximize potential profit if I win, while avoiding overbidding and incurring a loss. Since all bidders are rational, they will likely bid slightly less than their values too. I will bid $8.9 to ensure a potential win without paying more than my value.

Given my value of $40, I should bid slightly below it to maximize profit while still having a good chance of winning. Rational bidders will bid below their values to avoid negative profit. Bidding $39.9 ensures I win if others bid similarly rationally below their values. This bid maximizes my chance of profit while staying competitive.

Given my value of $32, I need to bid just enough to win but not too much to reduce profit. The optimal bid is slightly below my value to ensure a positive profit margin if I win. I estimate the average bid to be around the midpoint ($24.5), so I'll bid slightly above to increase winning chances while maintaining profit.
